description: The bar chart compares the performance of two models, Flan-T5-783M (blue bars) and another model (red bars), across six different tasks, with performance measured on a scale from 25 to 85. The tasks are grouped by dataset and format: TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1). For each task, the blue bar (Flan-T5-783M) consistently shows a higher score than the red bar. The highest performance is observed in the TriviaQA (F1) task, where Flan-T5-783M achieves a score of 82.8 and the other model achieves 83.8. The lowest performance is in the 2Wiki (EM) task, with scores of 44.5 and 32.5 for the two models, respectively. The chart shows that the model performance varies significantly across different tasks, with the Flan-T5-783M model generally outperforming the other model, except in the TriviaQA (F1) task where the other model has a slightly higher score.
